moments.title: Love Island 2026 Final Tonight
moments.blurb: The 13th series of Love Island UK concludes tonight with the grand final live from Mallorca, crowning this year's winning couple.

angles.name: Final Showdown
angles.copy: Tonight's the night! After eight weeks of drama, romance, and 'I've got a text!', who will be crowned the Love Island 2026 winners? Get ready for the final showdown on ITV2. #LoveIsland

angles.name: Your Predictions
angles.copy: From bombshells to fire pit confessions, it's all led to this. Who are you backing to win Love Island 2026 tonight? We'll be glued to ITV2 at 9pm!

moments.title: Glasgow 2026 Commonwealth Games in Full Swing
moments.blurb: The Commonwealth Games are ongoing in Glasgow until August 2nd, with today (July 27) featuring athletics kicking off and multiple medal sessions in gymnastics, weightlifting, and swimming.

angles.name: Medal Monday
angles.copy: It's Day 4 of the Glasgow 2026 Commonwealth Games! Athletics begins today, plus more medal opportunities in gymnastics, weightlifting, and swimming. Who are you cheering for?

angles.name: Glasgow Shines
angles.copy: Our city is buzzing! The Commonwealth Games continue in Glasgow with a packed schedule of events. What's been your highlight so far?

moments.title: Lando Norris Wins Hungarian Grand Prix
moments.blurb: McLaren's Lando Norris secured his first Grand Prix victory of 2026 yesterday (July 26th) at a dramatic Hungarian Grand Prix, beating Max Verstappen and Kimi Antonelli.

angles.name: Norris's Triumph
angles.copy: What a race! Lando Norris took a stunning victory at the Hungarian Grand Prix yesterday. Was that the win you were expecting? F1 is truly delivering this season!

angles.name: McLaren's Pace
angles.copy: First win of 2026 for Lando Norris and McLaren! The Hungarian GP was packed with drama. Where does this put McLaren in the championship fight?

moments.title: Luke Combs Heads To Wembley
moments.blurb: Country superstar Luke Combs is set to play three massive shows at London's Wembley Stadium from July 31st to August 2nd, with support from The Castellows, Ty Myers, and Thomas Rhett.

angles.name: Country Takes Over London
angles.copy: Wembley Stadium is about to get a dose of country! Luke Combs kicks off his three-night residency this Friday. Who's got tickets?

angles.name: Weekend Plans Sorted
angles.copy: If you're heading to see Luke Combs at Wembley this weekend, prepare for some incredible live music! Three nights of pure country magic.

moments.title: Strictly Announces New Pro Dancers
moments.blurb: Five new professional dancers – Aleksandra Isaeva, Cristian Priori, Lethabo Monametsi, Maddie Ingoldsby, and Mark Karmalita – have been announced for the upcoming 24th series of Strictly Come Dancing, which launches in September.

angles.name: New Faces On The Dancefloor
angles.copy: Get ready for some fresh talent! Strictly Come Dancing has announced five new professional dancers joining the show for its 24th series. Who are you most excited to see?

angles.name: Building Anticipation
angles.copy: The Strictly ballroom is getting bigger! With new hosts and now new pro dancers, the September launch can't come soon enough. What's your favourite Strictly moment?

moments.title: Bobbie Gentry is 84 Today
moments.blurb: American singer-songwriter and guitarist Bobbie Gentry, known for her hit 'Ode to Billie Joe', celebrates her 84th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Bobbie
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 84th Birthday to the iconic Bobbie Gentry! Her timeless 'Ode to Billie Joe' remains a classic. What's your favourite Bobbie Gentry track?

angles.name: Legendary Songwriter
angles.copy: Celebrating the birthday of the legendary Bobbie Gentry today! A true pioneer as one of the first female artists to compose and produce her own music. Happy 84th!

moments.title: Butch Vig Turns 71
moments.blurb: August 2nd marks the 71st birthday of acclaimed music producer and Garbage drummer, Butch Vig, known for his work on iconic albums like Nirvana's 'Nevermind'.

angles.name: Production Powerhouse
angles.copy: Happy 71st Birthday to the legendary Butch Vig on August 2nd! From drumming in Garbage to producing Nirvana's 'Nevermind', his impact on music is immense. What's your favourite album he produced?

angles.name: Garbage Drummer Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy Birthday to Butch Vig this Sunday! The incredible drummer for Garbage and producer behind some of the biggest 90s albums. Celebrate with a classic track!

moments.title: Charli XCX is 34 on Sunday
moments.blurb: British pop sensation Charli XCX, known for her innovative sound and chart hits, will celebrate her 34th birthday on August 2nd.

angles.name: Pop Queen's Birthday
angles.copy: Get ready to celebrate on Sunday as Charli XCX turns 34! The pop innovator always brings the bangers. What's your go-to Charli XCX track?

angles.name: Dance Pop Birthday
angles.copy: Happy Birthday to Charli XCX this Sunday! The artist redefining pop and dance music turns 34. Crank up her tunes this weekend!

moments.title: UK School Summer Holidays Underway
moments.blurb: School summer holidays are now in full swing across much of the UK, with children in England and Wales typically off until early September, while Scotland and Northern Ireland started earlier.

angles.name: Summer Fun Begins
angles.copy: The school summer holidays are officially here for millions across the UK! What are your plans for keeping the kids entertained this summer? Share your top tips!

angles.name: Local Summer Adventures
angles.copy: Devon schools are out for summer! If you're looking for local activities to keep the family busy, we've got you covered. What's your favourite local summer spot?
